Project Name

Supply Management

Web Application

Stack

Professional Project

Description.

This project is a web application designed to optimize supply management within a company. It allows users to track orders, manage inventory, and plan purchases efficiently and in real-time.

Inventory Management

Continuous monitoring of stock levels with alerts for items that need to be replenished. Users can adjust stock levels and view inventory history.

Reports & Analytics

Generation of detailed reports on costs, purchase volumes, and supplier performance for informed decision-making.

Smart Management

Integration of automated ordering system converting user selections into ingredient lists sent to the logistics team.

Supplier Management

Integrated database to manage supplier information, contract terms, and order history.
